content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Deoghar
content_sections.text: AIIMS Deoghar is an Institution of National Importance under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India. The notice carries the address At- Devipur Campus, Ramsagar, Deoghar, Jharkhand. Its website is www.aiimsdeoghar.edu.in . This is a government recruitment for posts filled on deputation, not direct recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I bio-data and Annexure-II certificate by the employer/cadre controlling authority) to the address below, by Speed Post or Registered Post only. The Dy. Director (Administration), All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Deoghar, At- Devipur Campus, Ramsagar, Deoghar-814117, Jharkhand. The application form, eligibility criteria, desirable qualifications/experience and related details are on www.aiimsdeoghar.edu.in and www.pmssy-mohfw.nic.in . For clarification and enquiries, the notice gives the email address [email protected] . Applicants may send one advance copy of the application, but only an application through proper channel will be considered.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Annexure-I bio-data/curriculum vitae proforma with a recent passport size photograph. Annexure-II certificate by the employer/cadre controlling authority, certifying that the details are correct, the officer is clear from vigilance angle, no vigilance, criminal or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated, and integrity is certified. CR Dossier in original, or photocopies of the ACRs for the last five years attested by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary of the Govt. of India or above. Either a statement that no major/minor penalty was imposed in the last 10 years, or a list of the major/minor penalties imposed in that period. Duly attested photocopies of up-to-date qualification and experience certificates, promotion/upgradation orders and Confidential Reports (at least for the latest 5 years). Where the applicant's organisation does not follow Central Government pay scales, the latest salary slip showing basic pay with scale and rate of increment, dearness pay/interim relief/other allowances, and total emoluments. Supporting documents if the applicant belongs to SC/ST. For officers already on deputation: cadre clearance, vigilance clearance and integrity certificate from the parent cadre/department.

Candidates are asked to produce all original supporting documents at the time of interview. Mere eligibility does not vest any right in a candidate to be called for interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are vacant in AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 17 posts in nine designations: Executive Engineer (Civil) 1, Executive Engineer (Electrical) 1, Nursing Superintendent 2, Deputy Nursing Superintendent 2, Assistant Administrative Officer 2, Assistant Accounts Officer 3, Chief Pharmacist 1, Junior Administrative Officer 1 and UDC 4. The number is tentative.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Deoghar deputation posts?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of application at AIIMS Deoghar is 45 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News. The advertisement also gives 30 days from that publication as the last date for submission through proper channel. The notice prints no calendar date.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for the AIIMS Deoghar deputation posts?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I and Annexure-II), through proper channel, by Speed Post or Registered Post only, to the Dy. Director (Administration), AIIMS Deoghar, Devipur Campus, Ramsagar, Deoghar-814117, Jharkhand.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AIIMS Deoghar deputation?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 56 years as on the last date of receipt of application, for all the posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for AIIMS Deoghar deputation posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Level 11 (Rs. 67700 – 208700) for Executive Engineers and Nursing Superintendent to Level 04 (Rs. 25500 – 81100) for UDC. The post also carries the usual allowance admissible to Central Government employees of similar status stationed at Deoghar.

faq.question: Q6. Who can apply for AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Officers under the Central/State/UT Government, universities, statutory/autonomous bodies or R&D organisations holding analogous posts on regular basis, or officers in the feeder grade with the regular service stated for each post. Posts such as Nursing Superintendent are open to a narrower list of bodies.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification for the UDC post?
faq.answer: An officer holding an analogous post on regular basis, OR one with 8 years regular service in the grade pay of Rs. 1900 who has a degree from a recognized University or its equivalent.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the deputation period?
faq.answer: The initial period of deputation is 3 years or until the appointment of a regular incumbent, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate application is required for each post.

faq.question: Q10. Will applications without vigilance clearance be considered?
faq.answer: No. Applications without vigilance clearance and CR Dossiers will not be considered, and only applications through proper channel will be considered.
